U.note: Clean four-block sandbox with counts, undo, keys and good mobile layout, but opens empty and visually plain.

V.note: Textured pixel blocks, sky, clouds and a pre-built landscape with nine block types make it the most polished and inviting, with a wrapping mobile palette.

W.note: Feature-rich with Place, Erase, Pick and Fill tools, but the block look is flat and the toolbar is cramped.

X.note: Attractive beveled blocks and a starter scene with ten palette slots, undo and a status line, and it works well on mobile.

Y.note: Works with a Generate button but looks dim, with grid artifacts and tiny labels, and starts as an empty dark grid.

Z.note: Tidy counters per block type and a hint line, with the world starting empty and plain.
